criteria.reason: Detailed, organized explanation of all pillars, 3a mechanics, and user-specific decision factors; meets requested depth.
Mostly accurate, but Pillar 1 rate/purpose, 3a limit, and departure-withdrawal condition are imprecise or outdated.
Clear headings, tables, checklist, and plain language make it accessible for a newcomer.

factual_errors: The stated 2024 3a limit (CHF 7,056 / 35,280) is outdated; 2024 limits were CHF 7,258 / 36,290.
Pillar 1 is described as AHV/AVS at 8.7% while also covering disability; AHV/IV/EO total is 11% and AHV/AVS excludes disability.
Early 3a withdrawal for departure depends on ceasing Swiss social security coverage, not EU/EFTA citizenship.
summary: Comprehensive and well-structured, but minor inaccuracies in Pillar 1 details, 3a limit, and departure rules.
